blocks.text: Every admissible map is an operation of the graph algebra. Congruences preserve each operation, so the image of a seed pair still belongs to θ.
blocks.title: Admissible images

blocks.text: If the endpoints of a path are θ-related, symmetry relates them in the opposite order.
blocks.title: Reversed paths

blocks.text: If x θ y and y θ z, transitivity gives x θ z.
blocks.title: Concatenated paths

introduction: Suppose every seed pair belongs to a congruence θ of the graph algebra. A marked edge is the image of a seed pair under a color-decreasing map. Connected pairs are obtained from marked edges by reflexivity, reversal, and concatenation. Induction on that construction shows that every connected pair belongs to θ.
title: Paths preserve the congruence
